title: Richard Dawkins demonstrates laryngeal nerve of the giraffe
summary: A clip from Channel 4's Inside Nature's Giants in which Richard Dawkins shows the recurrent laryngeal nerve of the giraffe during a dissection. The nerve takes a long detour down the neck and back up.
why: HN uses it as the canonical example that evolution is not optimal and can get stuck in local maxima.

quote.text: The bit about the recurrent laryngeal nerve of the giraffe is particulary memorable
